response: ["The licensed guideline corpus contains no recommendation for the condition 'MISC'.","Guidance for melanoma (MEL) is available in the licensed guideline corpus.","Surgical excision with histologically negative margins is the recommended first‑line treatment for primary cutaneous melanoma (CM) of any thickness.","Surgical excision with histologically negative margins is also the recommended first‑line treatment for melanoma in situ.","Surgical margins for melanoma should be based on tumor thickness.","Sentinel lymph node biopsy (SLNB) should be performed before wide excision of the primary tumor when indicated.","Sentinel lymph node biopsy should be performed in the same operative setting as wide excision whenever possible.","When melanoma is suspected, the whole lesion should be completely excised with a narrow margin of 1–3 mm to perform histological diagnosis.","Incisional biopsies can be performed on large lesions such as those on the face (e.g., lentigo maligna), acral lesions, and genitalia.","The recommendation for primary excision is a consensus‑based recommendation with a consensus rate of 100 % (21/21)."]
